summary.text: Manka Dhingra is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate representing District 45, where she took office in 2017, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Her professional background includes work as a senior deputy prosecuting attorney with the King County Prosecuting Attorney's Office.

paragraphs.text: Manka Dhingra earned a B.A. in history and political science from the University of California at Berkeley and a J.D. from the University of Washington School of Law.
She began working as a prosecutor in January 2000 and later became a senior deputy prosecuting attorney with the King County Prosecuting Attorney's Office.
Dhingra assumed office in the state Senate in 2017.
In 2024 she ran in the nonpartisan primary for Washington Attorney General, finishing third with 22.5 percent of the vote behind Pete Serrano and Nick Brown.
Her Senate committee assignments for 2023-2024 were Health & Long Term Care, Law & Justice, where she was chair, and Ways & Means.
